policy.definition: From 18 Sep 2024 onwards: official central bank steering rate is the deposit facility rate, fixed rate; from 15 Oct 2008 to 17 Sep 2024: official central bank liquidity providing, main refinancing operations, fixed rate; from 28 Jun 2000 to 14 Oct 2008: official central bank liquidity providing, main refinancing operations, minimum bid rate; from 5 Jan 1999 to 27 Jun 2000: official central bank liquidity providing, main refinancing operations, fixed rate.
From 3 Apr 2001 onwards: official repo overnight rate; from 1 Jan 1946 to 2 Apr 2001: oank rate.

From 3 Aug 2006 onwards: official bank rate; from 6 May 1997 to 2 Aug 2006: repo rate; from 20 Aug 1981 to 5 May 1997: minimum Bank of England Band 1 dealing rate; from 16 Oct 1972 to 19 Aug 1981: minimum lending rate; from 1 Jan 1946 to 15 Oct 1972: bank rate.

From 24 Sep 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.25 percent; From 17 Jun 2026 to 23 Sep 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.00 percent; From 22 Dec 2025 to 16 Jun 2026: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 0.75 percent; From 27 Jan 2025 to 21 Dec 2025: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 0.50 percent; From 1 Aug 2024 to 26 Jan 2025: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0.25% ; From 21 Mar 2024 to 31 July: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1 %; from 21 Sep 2016 to 20 Mar 2024: the BOJ set the guideline for market operations which specifies a short-term policy interest rate at minus 0.1% and a target level of 10-year JGB yields at around 0%. Short-term policy interest rate; from 4 Apr 2013 to 20 Sep 2016: no policy rate; from 5 Oct 2010 to 3 Apr 2013: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1%; from 19 Dec 2008 to 4 Oct 2010: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0. %; from 31 Oct 2008 to 18 Dec 2008: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0.3%; before 30 Oct 2008, refer to https://data.bis.org/topics/CBPOL
From 7 Mar 2008 onwards: Bank of Korea base rate; from 6 May 1999 to 6 Mar 2008: target overnight call rate(base rate).
From 2 Aug 1990 onwards: cash rate target; from 23 Jan 1990 to 1 Aug 1990: middle of the cash rate target range; from 7 Apr 1976 to 22 Jan 1990: interbank overnight cash rate.

policy_decisions.rationale_en: Energy-price persistence raises inflation risks. Soft labour conditions and higher borrowing costs pull the other way; three members favoured an increase.
policy_decisions.rationale_zh: 能源价格持续偏高加大通胀风险；劳动力市场偏软与借贷成本上升形成反向影响。三名委员主张加息。

policy_decisions.provider: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
policy_decisions.rationale_en: The CBC balanced contained inflation and strong activity against global uncertainty. A discount-rate hold can coexist with rising market borrowing costs.
policy_decisions.rationale_zh: 台湾央行权衡可控通胀、强劲经济活动与全球不确定性。贴现率维持不变，并不代表市场借贷成本不会上升。
